annotations.title: Suggest the contact of lines that name nobody

description: For each open line on a receivable or payable account that names no contact — typically the open items of books imported line by line — the contacts it could be, best first, each with a score, the method (a learned motif, the number of a document of the company quoted in the label, the description or the reference of the entry, the words of a contact's name), the evidence in a sentence, and alternatives: how many contacts the same evidence reached. More than 1 is a question for the user, not an answer. It writes nothing; set_line_contact names a line once the user has chosen.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.

line_ids.description: The ledger lines to ask about. Left out: every open line of the company on a receivable or payable account that names no contact.

name: suggest_line_contacts
title: Suggest the contact of lines that name nobody
